title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-07-29) — the July 2027 Consumer Confidence print falls inside it
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf, whose content streams were inflated and whose shaded cells were decoded in-session on 2026-09-05 by the fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17 research already in this calendar -- a decode this session did not re-run and does not claim to have re-run. That entry's own source field records the decoded 2027 windows verbatim: "Jan 16-28, Mar 6-18, APR 17-29, May 29 -> Jun 10, JUL 17-29, Sep 4-16, Oct 16-28, Nov 27 -> Dec 9", validated first against the PDF's 2026 page (which returned Sep 5-17 / Oct 17-29 / Nov 28 -> Dec 10, matching three sibling ledgers exactly). So 2027-07-17 -> 2027-07-29 is the Board's own shaded window, cited from this repo's existing decode rather than re-derived. It is CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY here by the policy footnote the same document states verbatim -- "the blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting ... if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier" -- applied to the July 2027 meeting read this session off fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 2027 panel "July | 27-28", no SEP): Jul 27 2027 is a Tuesday, ten days earlier is Saturday 2027-07-17, and the meeting ends Wednesday Jul 28 so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-07-29. The same arithmetic reproduces all four 2027 blackout entries this calendar already carries (01-16, 03-06, 04-17, 05-29) to the day. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule and a decoded shading applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date -- fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is "tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-06-08/09 meeting, not a better fetch. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-07-27 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: Proposed during the consumer-confidence-2027-07-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), which found ZERO tracked events anywhere in July or August 2027. What earns this a slot rather than being a duplicate of the decision entry is that THIS PRINT LANDS INSIDE THE GATE, and so does most of the panel behind it. The blackout runs 2027-07-17 -> 2027-07-29; the July 2027 Consumer Confidence edition releases 10:00 a.m. ET on 2027-07-27, ten days in, and its field window -- projected from July's OWN sourced cut-off lags of 5/6/8 days (CCI-July-2022 "cutoff date for the preliminary results was July 21", CCI-July-2023 "July 19", CCI-July-2024 "July 22, 2024") plus the sixteen-day field length CCI-Apr-2023 states -- runs roughly 07-04/07 -> 07-19/22, so its final three to five days are fielded with the Committee silent. This completes a geometry that is structural to July rather than particular to 2027: a July panel is 100% post-SEP-decision (it opens weeks after the June dot plot) AND closes before the July FOMC convenes, 7 of 7 across 2021-2027, which makes July the cleanest Fed-to-sentiment transmission site this chain has and the blackout the reason the last stretch of the panel cannot be contaminated by Fed speech either. The first session in which any official may speak again is Friday 2027-07-30 -- which is also July's last session, and the session on which AAPL's and AMZN's Q2 reports would land under the +2 filing pattern measured this session off EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 dates (both filed exactly two sessions after the July print in five of six years). SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS THE OTHER RATE ENTRIES: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates- or macro-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
